name: marbled_pour
description: marbled paint: flat inks poured in hard-edged bands and combed into folds, hooks and S-curls that tighten towards the set, no light and no gradient
reuses: stirred_ink's stir: two passes along the level lines of turned copies of the fractal
the paper pass's flat sheets cut from the smooth count, each one ink of the map (gouache_cut's hop)
notes: From wallhaven-xl8gmd (item 089, triage group 11, poured paint), with wallhaven-dp6vvj as the entry teal_marbling. No new engine member: stirred_ink's stir carries the frame, and the paper pass cuts the stirred smooth count into 16 flat sheets on its rank, each one ink of the map (`hop` 0.125 reads the eight inks' middles in turn, so neighbouring bands are far apart on it), so every band is a flat ink with a hard edge and the stir combs the bands into marbling. A thin `shadow` (0.004, colour a dark umber) lays a dark vein along each edge. No light, no gradient, no crest: that is what keeps it apart from stirred_ink, the nearest mode (its baseline tile in both formulation rows), whose one glossy ink is lit along the folds.
Reachable by one escape loop: yes. The frame's loop plus the stir's seven (two passes, 4 and 3 steps), no light, so no Jacobian; the paper pass reads the height the frame already has.

Round one's readings: f_broad (10 sheets: broader bands, closest to xl8gmd's), f_strong (the stir at 7 over 8 steps and 4 over 4), f_flat (no vein), f_nostir (the set's bands as flat inks: poster_curls' look). A dry-brush `ragged` comb (reach 0.012) frayed every edge into noise in the lace and left the drafts. teal_marbling (dp6vvj) walks its map end to end over 14 sheets (`hop` 1/14), a white vein thrown away from the light, and a gentler stir (strength 2 and 2, the fine pass at period 1).

Tone: the sheets are cut on rank, so each ink holds a share of the frame fixed by `levels` and `taper`, and the map carries the reference's spread; the tone pass only nudges it. Three map re-tunes (creams lowered to L* about 0.82, the dark umber made the first, far-field ink) took the white share from up to 0.15 to 0 but held only 6 of 14 picker tiles at `taper` 0.95: at lace-heavy seats the stirred lace's fine bands average into mid-tone speckle (p10 0.21 to 0.24 against 0.153), and no tone curve spreads that at both ends. `taper` 0.8 gives the far-field sheets the area and fixed it: all 14 picker tiles hold as shipped (median 0.568 to 0.586, p10 0.152 to 0.156 against 0.589/0.153); 0.65 drowned the frame in umber and cream. teal_marbling held at both its seats against dp6vvj.

Explorer cost (089, no held box: an upper bound): 47 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest formulation seat (julia-mandelbrot_df5d31a1, maxiter 11,005), whole frame with the paper pass; 45 s without it, so the pass is about a second and the stir's seven loops are the rest.

Published stack set to its kept reading (Matt, 2026-11-26, the lever rule; item 094): the paper pass's `levels` 16 became 10, f_broad's, since the card's Example must draw its kept tile and f_broad was drawn at 10. f_nostir, kept beside it in the default entry, was drawn at 16 without the stir, so no default stack draws it, before this change or after. The tone figures above were read at 16.
